build_xlnet_language_model: build an XLNet language model with XLNetLMHeadModel for next-token prediction
create_xlnet_sequence_classifier: create an XLNet sequence classifier with XLNetForSequenceClassification for GLUE tasks
build_xlnet_question_answerer: build an XLNet question answering model with XLNetForQuestionAnswering for extractive QA
run_xlnet_forward_pass: run an XLNet forward pass with XLNetModel to get hidden states and memory caches
